description_en: Queries the statistics on the data volume of completed migration tasks for each data source in the current region by day or hour
description_zh: 按天或按小时查询当前用户在当前地域下各数据源已完成迁移任务的数据量统计
name: GetSpeed

parameters.help_en: The start time for statistics collection. If interval is set to DAY, statistics are collected by date, and the first 10 characters of the value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd format. If interval is set to HOUR, the value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format, with the date and time separated by the letter T
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间。interval为DAY时按日期统计，取值前10位格式为yyyy-MM-dd；interval为HOUR时使用yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss格式，日期和时间之间以字符T分隔
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The end time for statistics collection. If interval is set to DAY, statistics are collected by date, and the first 10 characters of the value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd format. If interval is set to HOUR, the value must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format, with the date and time separated by the letter T
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间。interval为DAY时按日期统计，取值前10位格式为yyyy-MM-dd；interval为HOUR时使用yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss格式，日期和时间之间以字符T分隔
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en: The statistical granularity. Valid values: DAY: statistics are collected by day. HOUR: statistics are collected by hour. Default value: DAY. The value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 统计粒度。可选值：DAY表示按天统计，HOUR表示按小时统计。默认值为DAY，不区分大小写
parameters.name: interval

data.description_en: The statistics on the migration speed

detail.description_en: The list of statistics on the migration data volume for each data source
detail.description_zh: 各数据源的迁移数据量统计列表

sourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source

sourceName.description_en: The name of the data source

value.description_en: The list of migration data volumes aggregated by the specified granularity for the data source
value.description_zh: 该数据源按指定粒度聚合的迁移数据量列表

readSize.description_en: The actual data volume read for completed migration tasks, in bytes
readSize.description_zh: 已完成迁移任务实际读取的数据量，单位为字节

size.description_en: The planned data volume of completed migration tasks, in bytes
size.description_zh: 已完成迁移任务的计划数据量，单位为字节

time.description_en: The statistical time. The format is yyyy-MM-dd when statistics are collected by day, and yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH when statistics are collected by hour
time.description_zh: 统计时间。按天统计时格式为yyyy-MM-dd，按小时统计时格式为yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH
